name: Taikoubou
source:
Taikoubou is a great strategist, sent by his master, GenshiTenjun-sama to complete the Houshin Plan and defeat SoDakki. He was given the list of demon names to seal (Houshin Shou), and leads the battle between Kihatsu and Chuuou. He is highly impatient when it comes to ordering others around and having them respond to his wishes, but is level headed when it comes to battles. Oddly, he cannot fight- being one of the weakest members of the group- but his fighting abilities lie in his brain as he easily is able to trick others during fights. However, his magical abilities are astounding… he possesses the ability to one shot Dakki, but the casting takes a long time. 

Taikoubou is greedy for money and enjoys counting coins and money stacks late into the night. He also has a rude mouth, yelling at Kihatsu and calling him an idiot. He is proud and likes to tease Yousen… their personalities often clashing, creating battles through witty words between the two….

[from [url=http://azurebluephoenix.tumblr.com/post/72077349897/lgs-houshin-engi-the-dating-sim]Sapphire Dreams Tumblr[/url]]
